guard: the send end-to-end smoke runs the repository's real bin/cotal.ts entry against its explicitly owned broker
why: The prior URL walked only to implementations/ and attempted implementations/bin/cotal.ts. Every delivery assertion was unreachable, and the suite stayed ungated.

The named precondition proves the subprocess entry exists before any command runs. The owned OS-assigned broker and explicit --server arguments make the real CLI path safe to run in CI and concurrently without borrowing an ambient mesh.

mutations.name: resolve the CLI from implementations/bin again
mutations.find:
const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../../", import.meta.url));
const cli = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../../bin/cotal.ts", import.meta.url));
mutations.replace:
const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../", import.meta.url));
const cli = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../bin/cotal.ts", import.meta.url));
mutations.expectRed: the subprocess entry is the repository's real bin/cotal.ts
mutations.cell: the subprocess entry is the repository's real bin/cotal.ts

mutations.name: the CLI subprocesses no longer receive the owned broker address
one-shot sends again derive their display name from the command verb
mutations.expectRed: `cotal send dm` without COTAL_NAME exits non-zero
mutations.cell: `cotal send dm` without COTAL_NAME exits non-zero

mutations.name: remove the awaited broker-exit barrier before JetStream tree removal
mutations.expectRed: the owned broker exits before its JetStream tree is removed
mutations.cell: the owned broker exits before its JetStream tree is removed
